claim: Combining target tracking and step scaling policies needs caution: if a step scaling policy starts a scale-in before the target tracking policy is ready to scale in, the scale-in is not blocked, and after it completes the target tracking policy could instruct the group to scale out again.

evidence.quote: We recommend caution, however, when using target tracking scaling policies with step scaling policies because conflicts between these policies can cause undesirable behavior. For example, if the step scaling policy initiates a scale in activity before the target tracking policy is ready to scale in, the scale in activity will not be blocked.
evidence.title: Dynamic scaling for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling
Dynamic scaling for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling
evidence.quote: After the scale in activity completes, the target tracking policy could instruct the group to scale out again.
